name: Sever the Dreaming Shadow

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
As you whisper to your pusaka, it attempts to cut away an enemy's shadow, leaving them in an eternal sleep. Your pusaka gains the following Activation.

Activate—Cut the Shadow 2 (concentrate, manipulate, mental)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect Your pusaka becomes a kris made of darkness and drives itself into an adjacent enemy's shadow. That enemy takes 80 mental damage with a basic Fortitude save save against your spell DC or class DC, whichever is higher. If this reduces the creature to 0 Hit Points, the target doesn't die, but its shadow is severed from its body, becoming a Shadow Spawn that attempts to flee from the target's body. As long as the shadow spawn exists, the target remains in a dreamless slumber; if destroyed, the target regains its shadow and awakens (if its body was kept properly while Unconscious).
